_comment: Subscription plans per tool, in USD per month. Copy to subscriptions.json (git-ignored) or edit in the dashboard: Pricing > Subscriptions. Each tool has a list of non-overlapping periods: start is YYYY-MM-DD, end is YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) or null for a plan that is still running. Cost per period = overlap days / 30.436875 x monthly_usd; days after a plan ends cost nothing. A plain number ("opencode": 0.0) is an undated plan that counts every day, the old format. Keys: claude-code, antigravity, opencode, codex, t3.
